modelText: Trial started with no card required, but confirmed as only 14 days ending Nov 16, 2026. Now I'll shop with member prices to test that claim.

In the cart the Ridge shoe is still $120.00 with $0 discount — no member price applied despite being logged in on the trial. I'll proceed to checkout to confirm the total and look for returns information.

Checkout confirms $120 total, $0 discount, free shipping. The returns claim has been repeated in site copy on the landing/welcome pages; I'll check the 30-day returns footer link for any fee or condition before finishing.

Checked all promises: a1 Trial — Ad promised 30 days free, no card. Landing/signup/confirmation all say 14 days only ('$9/month after your 14-day free trial', 'Trial length: 14 days', ends Nov 16, 2026). No credit card was required (name/email/password only), but 30-day length was NOT honored. a2 Member prices — Landing says 'Save on every order, including...the Ridge trail shoe', but after activating trial and clicking 'Shop with member prices', Ridge trail shoe (size 9) was $120.00 in shop, product page, cart and checkout, with Discount $0.00 and Total $120.00 (shipping Free) — no member price applied. a3 Free returns — Site consistently states 'Free returns on every order' / 'Send anything back free of charge. No restocking fees, no questions' on landing and welcome ('Your perks: member prices and free returns on every order'); no return fee/condition contradicting this was shown in cart/checkout (did not place order, payment not allowed).

verdicts.adQuote: Try Trail Club free for 30 days.
verdicts.reason: After signup the welcome page confirms a 14-day trial, not the advertised 30 days.
After joining Trail Club, the cart shows the Ridge trail shoe at full price with a $0.00 discount, so no member price was applied.

verdicts.pageQuote: Send anything back free of charge.
verdicts.reason: The Trail Club page confirms returns are free of charge, matching the advertised free returns.

fix.summary: Change Trail Club's trial length from 14 to 30 days in the membership settings.
fix.rationale: The ad promises a 30-day free trial, but the post-signup welcome page confirms a 14-day trial, so the funnel setting does not deliver the advertised offer.
steps: Open Store admin > Trail Club > Membership settings > Trial length.
Change Trial length from 14 days to 30 days and save.
Check it: complete a test signup at /store/trail-club and confirm the welcome page shows 'Trial length: 30 days'.
